meaning:
ὑστέρημα, -τος, τό
(ὑστερέω), [in LXX: Jdg.18:10 19:19-20, Psa.34:9 (מַחְסוֹר), Ecc.1:15 (חֶסְרוֹן), Est.6:9 (ὑ. εἶναι, חֲשַׁח) * ;]
(a) that which is lacking, deficiency, shortcoming: with genitive puss. (prop. pose.), 1Co.16:17, Php.2:30; with genitive of thing(s), Col.1:24, 1Th.3:10;
(b) need, want, poverty (Psa.34:10, Jdg.18:10, al.): Luk.21:4, 2Co.9:12 11:9; opposite to περίσσευμα, 2Co.8:13-14 (eccl.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack; that there may be…
because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which…
night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?
